player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleya {player_id} long Gem bilong Negosiasi.
Yu gat samting, na wok bilong yu em i mekim trai olsem na valui bilong samting yu gat bai i go ap.
Samting na valui ol i gat nau em i:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Long taim bilong yu, yu ken tokim opponent na mekim ofa bilong trai.
Usim tokene spesol ol i go long:
  - '[Ofa: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Ofa: Samting i ofa -> Samting i askim]
  - '[Accept]': Long akseptim ofa i kam.
  - '[Deny]': Long rifsim ofa i kam (default).
Gem em i go long {max_turns} taim olgeta.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Man i traim long kisim wanpela wok mani, tasol em i no gat ol samting bilong mekim dispela.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pleya {player_id}, Aksem i no inap. Kolom {col} i go pas boundari.
invalid_move.already_full: Pleya {player_id}, Aksem i no inap. Kolom {col} i ful.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Man {player_id} i traim long mekim wanpela trades taim em i no gat ol samting bilong baim.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Man {player_id} i mekim wanpela tok long baim em, tasol dispela tok bilong en i no stret.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Man {player_id} i no mekim wanpela nupela tok long baim em.

offers.reject: Man {player_id} i no laik senisim em.
offers.accept: Pleya {acceptor_id} i akseptim ofa bilong trai bilong Pleya {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Pleya {player_id} i mekim ofa bilong trai long Pleya {opponent_id}: Samting i ofa: {offered} -> Samting i askim: {requested}

outcome.win: Man {winner_id} i winim long rot bilong kisim bikpela mani moa.
outcome.draw: Same change in inventory value for all players. Draw.
